name: example
title: Example pack (synthetic codes)
description: A tiny pack that exercises the rule-pack format end to end: build, lint, fixtures and the coverage matrix. It cites only the synthetic codes TEST-CODE and TEST-ELEC, which stand for no real code, and its thresholds are invented.
attribution: Floorspec example pack (example 0.2.0) by the Floorspec contributors, CC BY 4.0, https://github.com/matdemers1/floorspec/tree/main/rules/example
jurisdiction: Nowhere: synthetic codes for testing the format

coverage.note: Ceiling heights are left to a later version of the pack; Core derives them since Core 0.3 (`ceilingHeight`).
Room widths at every point of a room that is not convex: the measure is deferred.
Riser heights of every stair; the goings of winders at the walkline and at their narrow ends; and the width, going at the walkline, risers and headroom of spiral stairs.
Smoke alarms in sleeping rooms only; carbon monoxide alarms are not checked.
